text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), one of the most 
prestigious races. With rain falling this 
year, even the sky looks gloomy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mejiro Palmer and Daitaku Helios 
never hung their heads before authority or 
rain clouds. Letting out a wild war cry of 
freedom, they took on the race.
